a.limits: This is a blind first read of two single frontal radiographs, with no lateral views, no indication and no dates. The prior is PA and the current is AP and underexposed, so no size change is reported for any finding. No measurements are given because the images carry no pixel scale and magnification is unknown. The images are downsampled, so fine detail such as margins, calcification, cavitation and subtle rib lesions should be reviewed on the source images in PACS. Patient identity match is assumed from the similar aortic contour and right basal abnormality and has not been verified. This is a draft for resident and attending review.

An effusion has not been adopted as a finding.
